scope: Supplied anonymized input, target, semanticChecks and output only. No model identities or other evaluation artifacts inspected.
limitations: Assistant linguistic judgment, not native-speaker or expert validation. Source corpus and checks are not human gold. Natural equivalents and equivalent clock notation accepted; register can vary by region/context. Whole wrong-script outputs are major; isolated mixed-script character defects with intact meaning are minor.
